usedFor: Kajabi holds offers and buyers, and Google Sheets holds your tracking rows, so “New Purchased” can run “Update Spreadsheet Row”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Purchased” in Kajabi, then “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Each purchase updates a row in your sheet, so buyers show up there without manual edits.

watchOut: “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets changes an existing row, so the row must already exist for a purchase.
